name: Woot-verlay
description: Pressure sensitive display for the analog values of your keyboard! Works with both Wooting and any standard or Hall Effect keyboards. Visit the page to mess around, or add it as a fully functional overlay to your streams.

paragraphs: Pressure-sensitive display for the analogue values of your Wooting keyboard! Visit the page to mess around, or add it as a fully functional overlay to your streams. Check out a demonstration here
This application only runs on Windows, but thanks to Sainan, here is a Linux altenative: Woot-verlay Linux
features: Woot-verlay is made to be extremely customisable. Right-click on keys to rename, change the fill direction or delete them. Drag the keys to shift them around. Grab the green or orange dotted edges of a key to resize.…
Presets are available to save and import. They can be found here in the project wiki!
A special mode for OSU! players that displays the Z and X keys with a histogram of the pressure values! View here and add to your streams using this link: OSU-lay page.
Make sure to make the display size in OBS at least 1300x700.
